answers.goal: Long term, I’d love to build a career creating and producing meaningful projects across music, film, and branded content. I’m excited by opportunities to learn every side of the industry, collaborate with talented people.
answers.drew: I’ve always been drawn to storytelling and the way creative work can make people feel something. Whether it’s music, film, branding, or live experiences, I love bringing ideas to life and creating work that connects with people. That passion led me to study communication at UCSB while pursuing music, filmmaking, and creative marketing, and it’s what continues to drive me today.
answers.seeking: I’m hoping to connect with creative, driven people across entertainment producers, directors, talent representatives, musicians, founders, and anyone passionate about building great work. I enjoy learning from people with different experiences and building genuine, long-term relationships.
answers.inspiration: I don’t have one single inspiration. I find inspiration in people who are passionate about what they do and are constantly pushing themselves to create better work, whether that’s in music, film, marketing, or business.
